response.basis: The supplied pair-0044 dossier, including the NL contract clauses, exact author-source and closed-model bindings, predicate plans, and backend receipts identified by their dossier bases and artifact manifest. Backend availability is treated only as an execution boundary.

decisions.basis: Pair-0044 dossier: NL5, exact InMotion/Accelerating/UnspecifiedInitial bindings, S2 plan, and completed false receipt.
decisions.reason: NL5 requires the system to begin in Accelerating. The exact InMotion-owned initial transition line 18 targets the exact synthetic UnspecifiedInitial state, while the exact Accelerating state is not reached by that owner-local entry. The possible interpretation that the synthetic state later selects Accelerating is excluded by the supplied closed facts, which show no such selection or reachable Accelerating entry; the separate root entry does not alter this local defect.
decisions.violated_obligation: The InMotion-owned initial edge must enter Accelerating.

decisions.basis: Pair-0044 dossier: NL3, exact EmergencyStopping binding, combined lifecycle action fact, and unsupported predicate receipt.
decisions.reason: NL3 requires EmergencyStopping to include a distinct Emergency Stop action. The exact closed-model fact exposes the combined abstract action EmergencyStopSendObstacleDetected, but does not establish whether that carrier decomposes into an independently identifiable Emergency Stop action. The supplied combined-action fact supports both a missing distinct carrier reading and a possible implementation-mediated decomposition, so the semantic issue is established with a surviving undercutting reading.
decisions.strongest_defeater: The combined lifecycle action EmergencyStopSendObstacleDetected may implement both Emergency Stop and obstacle signaling, although the supplied typed facts do not prove that decomposition.
decisions.violated_obligation: EmergencyStopping must include the distinct Emergency Stop action.

decisions.basis: Pair-0044 dossier: NL7, exact Cruising-to-Approaching transition binding, S5 plan, and completed receipt reporting no parsed guard.
decisions.reason: NL7 requires the Cruising-to-Approaching alternative to retain the independent guard approaches the destination. The exact transition line 21 has guard null. The event trigger is a separate typed field and cannot satisfy the independent guard requirement, so no competent alternative reading is supported.
decisions.violated_obligation: The exact Cruising-to-Approaching transition must have the independent guard approaches the destination.

decisions.basis: Pair-0044 dossier: NL2, exact Arrived event and Stopping transition bindings, R2 scenario, and completed false runtime receipt.
decisions.reason: NL2 requires the Arrived/Stop, Send Arrived stimulus to enter Stopping. The possibility of a runtime execution supporting the target is directly contradicted by the supplied completed trace, so it is not a surviving rebuttal.
decisions.violated_obligation: After the exact Arrived/Stop, Send Arrived stimulus, the system must enter and retain Stopping in the declared observation window.

decisions.basis: Pair-0044 dossier: NL5, exact InMotion/Accelerating/UnspecifiedInitial bindings, S2 plan, and completed false receipt.

decisions.basis: Pair-0044 dossier: NL3, exact EmergencyStopping binding, combined lifecycle action fact, and unsupported predicate receipt.

The exact closed-model fact exposes the combined abstract action EmergencyStopSendObstacleDetected, but does not establish whether that carrier decomposes into an independently identifiable Emergency Stop action. The supplied combined-action fact supports both a missing distinct carrier reading and a possible implementation-mediated decomposition, so the semantic issue is established with a surviving undercutting reading.
